stem: What happens next in this passage after “It was warm and soft.”?
options: The owner told him that everything was baked in the morning and that unsold bread was given to a children's center in the evening.
Every Saturday morning, volunteers cook soup at the community center.
The owner said the shop was not for everyone, but it showed another way to buy daily goods.
Ms. Lin gave him an old umbrella and told him to bring it back when he could.
